Who We Are

Wellness that takes you seriously.

Maddog Performance Health & Wellness is not a beauty bar or a day spa. We are a clinically supervised wellness facility — part of the Maddog Performance Institute in Ballito — designed to help you feel, perform and look your best through evidence-based protocols.

Whether you're a professional athlete recovering between bouts, a busy professional managing fatigue and stress, or someone ready to take control of their body composition — our clinical team tailors every protocol to your specific needs.

Our Services

One clinic. Complete care.

From a single IV drip to a full body composition programme — every service is available as a standalone or as part of an integrated wellness plan.

01 Intravenous Therapy

IV Drip Therapy

Nutrients delivered directly into your bloodstream — 100% bioavailability, immediate effect. From hydration and recovery to NAD+ anti-ageing and cognitive performance.

  • Hydration IV from R600
  • Myers Cocktail, Recovery & Inflammation IVs
  • NAD+ Energy, Performance & Anti-Aging
  • Glutathione Glow · Cognitive IV
  • Bespoke protocols designed around your bloodwork
Explore IV Therapy → 02 Body Composition

Body & Weight Management

Medical-grade weight management that's prescribed, monitored and clinically overseen. Not a quick fix — a structured protocol tailored to your body, your goals and your lifestyle.

  • Slimming clinic with doctor assessment
  • InBody body composition scanning
  • Personalised eating plan & nutrition education
  • Peptide therapy (prescribed, SAPHRA-approved)
Explore Body & Weight → 03 Contrast Therapy

Recovery Suite

The most powerful recovery protocol available — moving between extreme cold and intense heat. Reduces inflammation, accelerates muscle repair, sharpens mental clarity and improves sleep. Open to everyone, no gym membership required.

  • Cold plunge ice bath sessions
  • Infrared sauna sessions
  • Contrast therapy (combined) from R220
  • Monthly unlimited access from R900
Explore Recovery Suite → 04 Physiotherapy

Sports Physiotherapy

Evidence-based assessment and treatment for injuries, pain, movement limitation and athletic performance. Whether you're recovering from an injury or trying to prevent one, Robin works with you through every stage.

  • Initial assessment & treatment plan
  • Sports massage & manual therapy
  • Supervised rehabilitation
  • Home visits available (Ballito & surrounds)

Why Choose Us

The Maddog difference.

Clinic Environment
1
Clinically Supervised — Always

Every treatment is prescribed by our medical doctor and administered by a registered nurse. You will never receive a drip or protocol without a proper clinical assessment first.

2
Tailored to You — Not Off the Shelf

We don't do one-size-fits-all. Your protocol is designed around your bloodwork, your health history, your goals and your body — then adjusted as you progress.

3
Everything in One Place

IV therapy, contrast recovery, body composition, peptide therapy and physiotherapy — all under one roof. Your clinical team can coordinate your care across every area of wellness.

4
Open to Everyone

You don't need to be a gym member or an athlete. Our wellness clinic welcomes anyone who is ready to invest in how they feel, look and recover — from Ballito and beyond.
